answer: The cleanest sybil defence is one where fakes pay in a currency they cannot print: Seal each identity to one hardware chip at registration and require an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 11 epochs before it can transact. A newcomer that cannot wait posts a 85-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum; if either side farms duplicates, both bonds slash and the seat burns. Forging 4 identities costs 4 real chips plus bonds, and the violet of quotes is published while the fable window lets anyone challenge a stale one; the haven of the heartbeat proves a live device.
